cat > hourglass/timesheet.py <<'EOF'
# owner: platform
"""Weekly timesheet lines built from a list of shifts."""

from typing import List

from hourglass.schedule import worker_minutes
from hourglass.models import Shift
from hourglass.errors import ProjectError
from collections import Counter

def _check(shifts: List[Shift]) -> None:
    if not shifts:
        raise ProjectError("no shifts given")
    for shift in shifts:
        if not shift.worker.strip():
            raise ProjectError("blank worker name")

def _line(name: str, counts, totals) -> str:
    hours = totals[name] / 60
    return f"{name}: {counts[name]} shifts, {hours:.1f} hours"

def timesheet_lines(shifts: List[Shift]) -> List[str]:
    """One line per worker, most hours first."""
    _check(shifts)
    counts = Counter(shift.worker for shift in shifts)
    totals = worker_minutes(shifts)
    names = sorted(totals)
    names.sort(key=totals.get, reverse=True)
    return [_line(name, counts, totals) for name in names]
EOF
cat > tests/test_timesheet.py <<'EOF'
# owner: platform
import unittest
from hourglass.timesheet import timesheet_lines
from hourglass.parsing import parse_span
from hourglass.models import Shift
from hourglass.errors import ProjectError

def make(worker, text="09:00-12:30"):
    return Shift(worker, "mon", parse_span(text))

class TimesheetTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_busiest_first(self):
        shifts = [make("Ana"), make("Bo"), make("Bo")]
        self.assertEqual(timesheet_lines(shifts), [
            "Bo: 2 shifts, 7.0 hours",
            "Ana: 1 shifts, 3.5 hours"
        ])

    def test_empty(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            timesheet_lines([])

    def test_blank_worker(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            timesheet_lines([make("Ana"), make("  ")])
EOF

sed -i 's/{counts\[name\]} shifts, {hours:.1f} hours/{counts[name]} shifts, {hours:.1f} hrs/' hourglass/timesheet.py; sed -i 's/ hours"/ hrs"/' tests/test_timesheet.py; awk 'length>60' hourglass/timesheet.py tests/test_timesheet.py; HOURGLASS_ENV=test python3 -m unittest discover -s tests 2>&1 | tail -3; git add hourglass/timesheet.py tests/test_timesheet.py; git diff --cached --stat

sed -i '' 's/counts/jobs/g' hourglass/timesheet.py; awk 'length>60' hourglass/timesheet.py tests/test_timesheet.py; HOURGLASS_ENV=test python3 -m unittest discover -s tests 2>&1 | tail -3; git add hourglass/timesheet.py tests/test_timesheet.py; git diff --cached --stat

git commit -q -m "Add weekly timesheet lines per worker
